notes: Part of the PLAN 3.1 population sample: 15 skills drawn by even stride from the path-sorted library, one task each, to estimate how much of the library adds nothing measurable over a bare model. One task cannot characterise a skill — this measures the population, not this skill.

tasks.prompt: Critique this iOS sign-in form: email and password fields whose only labels are the placeholders "Email" and "Password", no AutoFill hints, and a generic "Login failed" message under the button.

expect.label: asks for textContentType so AutoFill works
sets an appropriate keyboard for the field
says the placeholder cannot be the only label
wants the error specific and attached to the field it concerns
